name: GD Streaks
description: Daily login streaks with a 7-day activity calendar.

show-counter.name: Show streak counter
show-counter.description: Show the number of days next to the flame icon in the main menu.

hide-button.name: Hide streak button
hide-button.description: Hide the flame button in the main menu entirely. Your streak still counts.

notifications.name: Streak notifications
notifications.description: Show a notification when your streak grows or resets, including special messages at 7, 14, 30, 50 and 100 days.
